title: Results Release, Report Copies and Corrected Reports — Laboratory Test Orders
content:
## Accessioning and the expected report date

A Laboratory Test Orders specimen is accessioned only if it arrives within its stability limit; otherwise it is rejected under the rejection rule. The expected report date is the accession (received) date plus the class's standard turnaround in business days, extended by any days the order spent on testing hold. Business days run Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays, and the accession date is day 0.

**Example (hypothetical, 3-business-day turnaround, no testing hold, no holiday).** A specimen accessioned on Monday 3 March has an expected report date of Thursday 6 March.

## Release of the final report

The final report is released to the ordering provider and to the patient portal at the same moment. The laboratory does not delay patient access. Its staff do not interpret results; interpretation is left to the ordering provider.

## Copies of a final report

A patient may request a copy of a final report of their own order at any time while the order is *resulted*. The order's status on record decides this. The copy is sent within the class's copy-fulfilment period in business days. It is free through the portal or to the provider, and charged at the class's paper-copy fee when mailed on paper.

## Corrected reports

When the laboratory confirms a demographic error, a result amendment or an added interpretive comment, a corrected report is issued within the class's corrected-report period in business days, at no charge. A patient's disagreement with a result is not an error and is referred to the ordering provider.

| Situation | Corrected report |
|---|---|
| Laboratory confirms a demographic error | Yes, at no charge |
| Laboratory confirms a result amendment | Yes, at no charge |
| Laboratory confirms an added interpretive comment | Yes, at no charge |
| Patient disagrees with a result | No; referred to the ordering provider |

## Specimen retention

A specimen is kept for the class's retention period in calendar days after the report date and then discarded. Once it is discarded, no add-on, repeat or confirmation can be run on it.
